reasoning.step1:
Classification: document is an invoice (contains "Factuurnummer", "Factuurdatum", totals, VAT lines).

Extraction plan and evidence (concise):
- Invoice.Date: explicitly "Factuurdatum 29    maart       2023" → "29 maart 2023".
- GrandTotal.Amount: "Totaal verschuldigd bedrag EUR 57,79" → 57.79.
- Sender.VatId: shows "BTW nummer UPS: NL007726892B01" (explicit sender VAT) → "NL007726892B01".
- VAT rate: shows "21 % BTW" and "21,00 % BTW" → rate 21.
- Net.Amount and Vat.Amount: page1 shows "Totaal BTW belastbaar 47,76" and "21 % BTW 10,03" which sum to total 57,79. Use Net.Amount 47.76 and Vat.Amount 10.03.
- Resolving minor conflicting figures on page2 (a 6,36 VAT for a line) — per rule 6, exchange-rate and per-line-only values excluded; choose invoice-level totals from page1 which match GrandTotal.

No guessing beyond explicit values; if any field missing, would be empty.
reasoning.step2:
Invoice.Date — confidence: high (95%)
- Evidence: Explicit header "Factuurdatum 29    maart       2023" on pages 1 and 2.
- Consistency: Same date appears twice.

GrandTotal.Amount — confidence: high (95%)
- Evidence: "Totaal verschuldigd bedrag EUR 57,79" on page 1.
- Consistency: Sum of reported taxable total (47,76) + VAT (10,03) = 57,79 matches.

Sender.VatId — confidence: high (90%)
- Evidence: Two VAT numbers shown; labeled "BTW nummer UPS: NL007726892B01" and earlier "BTW nummer klant: NL819593801B01".
- Rationale: Instruction requests sender VAT — document header shows "BTW nummer UPS" which indicates UPS as sender; chosen value NL007726892B01. Slight uncertainty only from ambiguity which is considered "sender" vs "customer".

Vat.Rate — confidence: high (95%)
- Evidence: "21 % BTW" and "21,00 % BTW" present; also VAT calculation aligns with 21%.

Net.Amount — confidence: high (95%)
- Evidence: "Totaal BTW belastbaar 47,76" shown on page 1 and reiterated on page 2.
- Consistency: Net (47,76) + VAT (10,03) = GrandTotal (57,79).

Vat.Amount — confidence: high (95%)
- Evidence: "21 % BTW 10,03" on page 1 and VAT line showing 21.00% → 6,36 appears on page 2 as per-line VAT for a specific shipment but invoice-level VAT is 10,03. Chosen invoice-level VAT 10,03.
- Consistency: Matches totals.

Overall note on ambiguity:
- Per-line VAT (6,36) exists but is per-item; per rules, only invoice-level VAT amounts used. Minor ambiguity only for Sender.VatId selection between two VAT numbers.
